polarization_transfer.qualification: DM pump return and ISO/BD0 path to be verified on bench

filter_positions.evidence: Catalog bounds only; no serial or raw curve received
filter_positions.action: Confirm actual AOI/cone, both polarizations, edge marking, fluorescence and serial data

filter_positions.evidence: Catalog bounds only; no serial or raw curve received
filter_positions.action: Use paired lot only after individual curves and installed-path check

filter_positions.pump_blocking: REQUEST OD >=5 over measured pump band
filter_positions.evidence: Project request, not a product guarantee
filter_positions.action: CWL from measured spectra; pointwise T/s,p/angle/temp and phase data required

filter_positions.pump_blocking: REQUEST OD >=5 over measured pump band
filter_positions.evidence: Project request, not a product guarantee
filter_positions.action: Fit pair transmission to both fixed-port joint spectra

filter_positions.band_810: REQUEST T >=0.95 over occupied band, H/V
filter_positions.pump_blocking: OD allocation 4 only if full 3 mW is used as upstream bound
filter_positions.evidence: No qualified curve / phase; allocation may be shared by other proven stages
filter_positions.action: Model reverse pump return, substrate and all scatter bypasses

filter_positions.band_810: REQUEST T >=0.95 over occupied band, H/V
filter_positions.pump_blocking: OD allocation 4 only if full 3 mW is used as upstream bound
filter_positions.evidence: No qualified curve / phase; allocation may be shared by other proven stages
filter_positions.action: R405 east to BD1; measured P405 before FB can replace conservative source bound

candidate_decisions.facts: 808 nm, 3 nm FWHM, peak T >90%, OD >5 in specified blocking bands
candidate_decisions.reason: Centre is 808 nm. Tilting blue-shifts it; no documented 810-nm matched passband. Reconsider only with actual changed operating wavelength.

candidate_decisions.facts: 810 nm, 10 nm FWHM, peak T >90%, OD >5 in specified blocking bands
candidate_decisions.reason: Bandwidth mismatch; use would require an explicit spectral-budget revision.
CW pump V is not converted into the required H pump; use H810-H405.

spectral_matrix.subject: Wavelength scale / line-spread function
spectral_matrix.configuration: 405 and 810 nm; fixed wavelength convention
spectral_matrix.method: Traceable wavelength reference, response calibration and measured LSF; pixel spacing is not resolution
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Pump LSF <=0.02 nm [P3]; daughter LSF <=min(0.05 nm, narrowest measured FWHM/10), new metrology target

spectral_matrix.subject: PBS direction/port map
spectral_matrix.configuration: W,E,N,S input; H,V,D,R; 405 and occupied 810 band
spectral_matrix.method: Low-power classical polarization measurements; T and R per used direction; Jones/Mueller fit
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Correct port map; ER >=1000:1 as project RFQ, including uncertainty; absolute loss separately

spectral_matrix.subject: HD axes / dual retardance
spectral_matrix.configuration: HD +Y and -Y; 405/810 bands; supplier temperature range
spectral_matrix.method: Fast-axis marking, physical-axis conversion and retardance fit; angle zero independent of motor label
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Half/half; |delta-pi mod 2pi| <=2pi/100 per RFQ; new axis allocation |dtheta|<=0.25 deg

spectral_matrix.subject: Mirror/dichroic polarization phases
spectral_matrix.configuration: M1,M2 AOI22.5; DM,DB AOI45
spectral_matrix.method: s/p transfer at actual angle and direction; field phase/dispersion or calibrated combined response
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Complex transfer available over occupied band, or bounded by end-to-end interference; missing data HOLD

spectral_matrix.subject: Single-direction unfiltered spectra
spectral_matrix.configuration: CW: A/H,B/V; CCW: A/V,B/H; safe pump blocking retained
spectral_matrix.method: Measure four response-corrected spectra at common actual pump wavelength/T; normalize exposure and crystal power
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Report each centroid, FWHM, multimodality, counts and uncertainty; no physical result is prefilled

spectral_matrix.subject: A/B and same-port comparisons
spectral_matrix.configuration: Fixed laboratory A/B; never relabel by output H/V
spectral_matrix.method: Report lambda_A-lambda_B per direction and CW-CCW difference separately for each port
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Same-port centroid gap <=0.05 nm is diagnostic target only; coherent overlap decides acceptance

spectral_matrix.subject: Temperature calibration
spectral_matrix.configuration: T0 from supplier/initial scan; T0+[-1,-0.5,-0.25,0,0.25,0.5,1] K within allowed range
spectral_matrix.method: Alternating CW/CCW; 3 complete cycles; record actual sensor readings and gradients; fit slopes and covariance
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Fit wavelength, width and rates; T uncertainty <=0.01 K target for fine study; no fixed invented tuning coefficient

spectral_matrix.subject: Independent temperature validation
spectral_matrix.configuration: T0+[-0.75,-0.15,+0.15,+0.75] K held out from fit, same safe range
spectral_matrix.method: Freeze fit before new runs; compare predicted spectra/rates with uncertainty and residual plots
spectral_matrix.acceptance: All adopted thermal limits must pass held-out prediction and coherent gate; else revise model before main run

spectral_matrix.subject: Filter curves / orientation
spectral_matrix.configuration: FA,FB each LP+BP; AOI0,+/-1,+/-2 deg; actual beam cone; Tlab +/-2 K if permitted
spectral_matrix.method: Measure serial-specific intensity T(lambda), H/V and actual angle; wavelength grid <=0.05 nm near 810
spectral_matrix.acceptance: 3 +/-0.5 nm FWHM, peak >=0.80; evaluate occupied-band throughput and phase, not only peak

spectral_matrix.subject: Pump rejection and detector guard
spectral_matrix.configuration: Each of four detector paths; full actual pump band and polarizations
spectral_matrix.method: Calibrated optical chain at progressively bounded power; attenuation/detector linearity checks; Poisson upper rate bound
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Per path OD >=max(6, derived OD_required); pump-related rate upper bound <=100/s new allocation; full background gate also required

spectral_matrix.subject: Fluorescence / scatter controls
spectral_matrix.configuration: Pump on with phase matching suppressed or matched blank path; pump off; each direction blocked
spectral_matrix.method: Keep dumps/filter geometry unchanged; inspect in-band counts and spectrum; test baffle bypasses
spectral_matrix.acceptance: No OD credit for bypass paths or fluorescence. Account for all measured excess in background budget

spectral_matrix.subject: Installed filtered spectra
spectral_matrix.configuration: Four direction/port spectra behind FA/FB; same spatial collection
spectral_matrix.method: Repeat SP-05 with final filters; response and pump normalization; record serials/axes
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Compare transmission-weighted predictions, counts and accepted widths with uncertainty; preserve raw records

spectral_matrix.subject: Joint spectrum / intensity overlap
spectral_matrix.configuration: Both directions in same A,B frequency coordinates after installed filters
spectral_matrix.method: Joint frequency grid with common response and integration weights; alternatively validated pump constraint plus conditional slices
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Report B upper bound, missing tail mass and resolution. B >=0.98 alone cannot pass coherent overlap

spectral_matrix.subject: Relative spectral phase / coherence
spectral_matrix.configuration: Calibrated phase and controlled delay scan at final ports
spectral_matrix.method: Independent analyzer phase/retardance variation and path delay; delay steps <=0.05 ps initial target around peak; retain singles
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Infer complex overlap with uncertainty; |gamma| lower bound >=0.98 allocation; report phase-dependent visibility independently

spectral_matrix.subject: Balance under operating pump split
spectral_matrix.configuration: Single-direction yields translated to actual P_CW and P_CCW
spectral_matrix.method: Set relative pump amplitude using measured rates and stable coupling; do not confuse efficiency with pump power
spectral_matrix.acceptance: b=2sqrt(r)/(1+r) lower bound >=0.995 allocation; report both incident crystal powers

spectral_matrix.subject: Residual phase and drift
spectral_matrix.configuration: Fixed carrier phase after calibration; full 2400 s duration
spectral_matrix.method: Repeated independent calibration checks; record phase and T/pump logs; main-run settings unchanged
spectral_matrix.acceptance: |residual phase|+U <=0.10 rad allocation; temperature +/-0.05 K and pump +/-2% existing targets

spectral_matrix.subject: Filter exchange control
spectral_matrix.configuration: Exchange A/B filter sets and restore original mounts
spectral_matrix.method: Recalibrate actual angle after swap; compare rates, centroids and contrast
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Diagnose filter-induced imbalance/phase; do not select the highest contrast subset post hoc

spectral_matrix.subject: Analyzer transfer / labels
spectral_matrix.configuration: A+,A-,B+,B-; H,V,D,A,R,L classical states
spectral_matrix.method: QA/QB zero and HA/HB signed angles, PBS output labels; four channel efficiencies retained
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Reproduce project measurement axes; analyzer contrast allocation >=0.995 if factorized model used

spectral_matrix.subject: Raw two-basis visibility
spectral_matrix.configuration: Both pumps; H/V and D/A independent calibration scans
spectral_matrix.method: Equal exposure; frozen fit convention and uncertainty; no subtraction from primary counts
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Measured raw visibility >=0.90 in both bases; report uncertainty and operational margin

spectral_matrix.subject: Accidentals / rate / coincidence controls
spectral_matrix.configuration: Full 2 ns window; four A/B output combinations; delayed +/-50,+/-100 ns
spectral_matrix.method: Fixed pairing rule and offset calibration; aggregate rates; darkness and blocked-path controls
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Delayed/central <=0.01 target; <=100000/s per channel; unique pairs and ambiguity gates unchanged

spectral_matrix.subject: Pump wavelength and temperature drift envelope
spectral_matrix.configuration: Measured extrema during 2400 s at final operating point
spectral_matrix.method: Fit local sensitivities, propagate covariance, validate corner combinations; include filter T/angle drift
spectral_matrix.acceptance: All same-port spectral/coherence and rate gates within uncertainty; no numeric wavelength drift limit before sensitivities

spectral_matrix.subject: Negative controls
spectral_matrix.configuration: One pump direction only; intentional phase/decoherence/delay change
spectral_matrix.method: Predefine expectation before acquisition; restore frozen configuration; preserve failed controls
spectral_matrix.acceptance: Single direction must not mimic required coherent D/A behavior; perturbation agrees with model within uncertainty

spectral_matrix.subject: Freeze / independent validation run
spectral_matrix.configuration: After SP-01..22 and electrical detector-chain acceptance
spectral_matrix.method: Archive configurations, source versions, calibrations, raw data and uncertainty; evaluate prefrozen gates
spectral_matrix.acceptance: No HOLD/unknown critical prerequisite. CHSH protocol, angles and statistics remain unchanged
